accessibility.apca_contrast: All text tokens meet AA / APCA standards (>60 Lc for regular body, >45 Lc for bold labels)
accessibility.color_blindness_safety: Risk levels use redundant indicators: Color + Icon (AlertTriangle/ShieldCheck) + Text Label (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL) + Numeric Score

seed_scenarios.title: Mild Tension Headache (LOW)
seed_scenarios.initial_message: I've had a dull aching headache on both sides of my head since yesterday afternoon after working at my computer.
seed_scenarios.why: Mild pain intensity, absence of 'red flag' neurological deficits (vision loss, neck stiffness, confusion), postural/screen trigger.
seed_scenarios.guidance: Rest in a quiet dimly lit room, maintain hydration, reduce screen glare, consider OTC analgesics if approved by physician.

seed_scenarios.title: Persistent Fever & Fatigue (MEDIUM)
seed_scenarios.initial_message: I've had a 101.5°F fever for 4 days now, accompanied by severe body aches, dry cough, and persistent fatigue that makes it hard to get out of bed.
seed_scenarios.why: Fever duration >72 hours, moderate fatigue interfering with daily activities, respiratory involvement without acute respiratory distress.
seed_scenarios.guidance: Schedule an in-person or telehealth clinical evaluation within 24-48 hours. Monitor temperature and pulse oximetry.

seed_scenarios.title: Acute Breathing Difficulty (HIGH)
seed_scenarios.initial_message: I am experiencing sudden shortness of breath when walking short distances, wheezing, and a tight sensation across my upper chest that started 3 hours ago.
seed_scenarios.why: Rapid onset of dyspnea at low exertion, audible wheezing, elevated age factor (61), potential cardiopulmonary compromise.
seed_scenarios.guidance: Seek urgent medical attention today at an Urgent Care or Emergency Department. Avoid exertion and remain seated upright.

seed_scenarios.title: Crushing Chest Pain & Dyspnea (CRITICAL)
seed_scenarios.initial_message: Severe crushing pressure in the center of my chest radiating to my left jaw and shoulder, sweating heavily, feeling dizzy and short of breath.
seed_scenarios.why: Classic cardiac 'red flag' constellation: radiating retrosternal crushing pain, autonomic symptoms (diaphoresis, presyncope), acute dyspnea.
seed_scenarios.guidance: CALL EMERGENCY SERVICES (911/112) IMMEDIATELY. Do not drive yourself. Rest in a semi-upright position while awaiting emergency responders.

disclaimer_and_safety.mandatory_text: MediSense AI is an artificial intelligence triage and preliminary assessment assistant for informational guidance only. It DOES NOT provide medical diagnosis or replace licensed clinical judgment. If experiencing severe symptoms, call 911 or visit the nearest ER immediately.
disclaimer_and_safety.never_use_term: Do NOT say 'Your diagnosis is'. ALWAYS use 'Preliminary Health Category' or 'Potential Pattern Match'.

instructions_to_main_agent.voice_mode_spec: Include a voice toggle button with simulated audio wave pulse visualizer, real-time speech-to-text transcript typing effect, and Vapi config placeholder modal.
instructions_to_main_agent.export_features: Include Print / PDF summary export with clean printable CSS styling for medical record handoff.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Follow clean medical aesthetics: Crisp white cards, Slate-900 typography, Teal-600 accents, subtle borders, no muddy gradients.
Prominent Emergency Banner: Sticky or top-level red alert banner with emergency phone action.
Explainability First: Always show 'Why this risk level' breakdown with factor weighting badges (+30 Rapid Onset, +25 Red Flag Symptom, etc.).
Interactive Scenario Switcher: Provide 1-click test scenario buttons in the Chat interface to test LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, and CRITICAL pathways instantly.
Strict Data Test IDs: Add data-testid on all interactive buttons, inputs, scenario chips, filters, and modals for automated testing.
